seo.title: Repair PDF — Free & Secure | JDpdf
seo.description: Fix a damaged or corrupted PDF file so it opens normally again. Free, fast, and private — no installation required.

subtitle: Fix a damaged PDF file that won't open correctly.

howItWorks.title: How to repair a PDF
steps: Click Repair to attempt to fix it.

items.q: What kinds of damage can this fix?
items.a: Common structural problems such as a broken cross-reference table or an invalid file trailer. Some files are damaged beyond recovery and can't be fixed by any tool.
Yes, repairing a PDF is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
